subject: Activation playbook: capacity lock request for StitchPoint (late-stage)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Connor OBrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity check request for StitchPoint late-stage commitment

Hi team,

StitchPoint is nearing signature on the Dedicated contract in our Q3 book. They sent an initial workload projection (attached) showing a 3 month ramp that would level at roughly 3500 concurrent chat sessions with 2.2 average tokens per second per session and a mix of short and long context workloads.

Ask: can infra confirm a recommended Dedicated sizing recommendation that meets the latency SLOs below, and whether we can place a provisional soft lock on capacity for two weeks while procurement completes? Specifics they asked us to guarantee if possible: 99th percentile latency < 180ms for 2k concurrent short sessions, and predictable burst capacity for larger batch jobs.

Prefer options expressed as: baseline node count and equivalent A100/H100 mix, burst allowance, and a simple estimate of monthly committed GPU hours. Also call out any caveats around quantization or model variants that would materially change the footprint.

I have looped Marcus and Laura for approvals if we need to escalate to dedicated pool reservation. I will reply to the customer once infra confirms a recommended option and availability windows.

Attachment: StitchPoint_Projected_Q3_workload.xlsx

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: Connor OBrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Jun 2029 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity check request for StitchPoint late-stage commitment

Aditya,

Thanks for the context and the workbook. Quick summary from infra after reviewing the traffic profile:

Option A - Predictable baseline (recommended)- 24x A100 80GB equivalent GPUs (can be a mixture of A100s and H100s) allocated to a single Dedicated pool- Autoscale floor to 18 nodes, burst to 32 nodes for scheduled ingest/batch windows- Estimated committed hours: 24 nodes * 24 hours * 30 days = 17,280 GPU-hours monthly- Notes: Meets the 99p < 180ms target for 2k short sessions with our continuous-batching profile and KV prefix caching.

Option B - Cost-optimized, mixed quantized path- 36x A100-quantized or 18x H100 with FP16 for peak shards- Burst to 48 for big batch runs, requires a 10% model-quality regression evaluation for quantized path- Lower unit cost but requires validation run during POC.

Availability and hold policy:
- Current inventory shows we can carve a soft hold for 2 weeks on Option A capacity starting as early as 2029-06-05. That hold is non-binding and can be released with 72 hours notice.
- For a hard committed reservation we need a signed PO and a ticket to commit nodes; lead time for hard lock is 7 business days to finalize provisioning and network isolation.

Attachments: capacity_snapshot_20290603.pdf (fleet slice and available spare nodes)

If you want I can open a PL-LOCK ticket with ops to place the soft hold and tag it to deal SP-2029-67. Need confirmation on which option and the desired start date.

Connor OBrien
Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Evan Park <evan@stitchpoint.com>, Mia Tan <mia.tan@stitchpoint.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Connor OBrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Jun 2029 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated sizing conversation - provisional hold and next steps

Evan and Mia,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Quick update from our side: we can provisionally reserve the Option A baseline (24x A100-equivalent) for a two week soft hold while you finalize procurement and signatures. The soft hold is non-binding and can be released with 72 hours notice. If you need a hard reservation tied to a PO we will convert the soft hold into a committed reservation once paperwork is complete, which typically needs 7 business days to finalize provisioning.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm you want the two-week soft hold starting Monday 2029-06-10.
2) Share any final POC runs that need the burst window so we can pre-approve burst capacity.
3) We will share a brief mutual action plan and a DocuSign for the Dedicated Terms. Link to the MAP will be emailed separately.

Connor in infra has attached a snapshot of current fleet availability and has offered to open PL-LOCK ticket PL-LOCK-6792 to place the soft hold. Laura is cc'ed for internal approval.

If this timeline works, I will confirm and ask Connor to open the soft hold ticket today.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Connor OBrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation playbook: capacity lock request for StitchPoint (late-stage)

Aditya and Connor,

Approve placing a two week soft hold for StitchPoint on the Option A profile starting today, 2029-06-10. Please follow the PL-LOCK process and tag the ticket to deal SP-2029-67. Make sure billing and legal are notified so we can accelerate PO conversion if they sign early.

Operational notes for Connor: please record the soft hold as PL-LOCK-6792 and include the following in the ticket body: baseline 24x A100-equivalent, autoscale floor 18, burst to 32, hold expiry 2029-06-24 23:59 PST. Also create an internal watch event on the capacity dashboard for any unexpected usage spikes against that slice.

Aditya, once you get confirmation from StitchPoint that they accept the soft hold start date, send them the MAP and the DocuSign link for Terms. If they sign the PO before 2029-06-24, convert the ticket to a hard reservation per standard runbook.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
VP, Production & Capacity, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
Attachment: PL_LOCK_ticket_PL-LOCK-6792.txt
